mainText: Hello, Verona! At 3 PM, here is today's balanced dish. We are enjoying 76 degrees with partly cloudy skies near City Hall. If you are out tonight, look up at 8:19 PM to see the International Space Station rise over Mount Horeb and travel almost directly overhead toward Fitchburg and Madison for a six-minute window.

The City of Verona has posted official notices regarding the upcoming November general election, and the police department is currently inviting residents to apply for their Citizen Academy to learn about topics like O W I investigations and K-9 unit operations.

There is plenty to do in town, with Yoga at Insight Wellness happening today and trivia at Hop Haus Brewing Company tonight. Looking ahead, you can catch live music at Bailey's Run Vineyard tomorrow and visit the Dane County Farmer's Market this Saturday.
Regarding local public safety, the Verona Police Department announced on September 4 that an investigation was opened following a report on Sunday, August 30, concerning a former school staff member.
Today's flavor of the day is the decadent Dark Chocolate Decadence. Culvers is currently open and serving until 10 PM tonight, so there is still plenty of time to stop by for a treat.
